name: EvoPrompt
one_liner: Connects evolutionary algorithms (Genetic Algorithm and Differential Evolution) with an LLM crossover/mutation operator scored on validation sets.

loop.proposes: An LLM performs evolutionary crossover and differential mutation on parent discrete instructions to generate child candidates.
loop.judged_by: A deterministic evaluation harness scores each child candidate across a development dataset and computes exact task metrics.
loop.steers: Roulette-wheel selection and population elitism keep top-scoring candidates for the next evolutionary generation.

headline_result: Outperformed human-engineered and gradient-free prompt baselines by up to 25% across 31 NLP and reasoning datasets.
caveat: Can overfit to a small development split if validation examples do not cover the test distribution.
beyond_harness_note: A Genetic Algorithm or Differential Evolution loop controls population selection and calls the LLM strictly as a semantic crossover/mutation operator.
algorithmic_authority: Genetic Algorithm / Differential Evolution controller and benchmark evaluator

sources.title: EvoPrompt: Connecting LLMs with Evolutionary Algorithms Yields Powerful Prompt Optimizers (ICLR 2024 / arXiv:2309.08532)

verification.notes: Checked against Guo et al., ICLR 2024. Title corrected to the printed title (ledger).
